title: Automate daily content + image refresh via configured online sources

requirements.text: Add backend support for automated content ingestion from admin-configured online sources (e.g., RSS/Atom feeds or JSON endpoints): store a list of sources, fetch and parse new items, and convert them into queued posts using the existing ingestion/publishing pipeline.

quotes: automate this website means online fetching images... every day you web is scrapping means online you search everything and automatically update and add every day daily news and educational use whatever the content related to my website.

acceptanceCriteria: Admin can create/read/update/delete (CRUD) a list of content sources (each source includes at minimum: name, URL, default category, enabled flag).
Backend can fetch enabled sources and ingest only new items (no duplicates on repeated runs).
Each ingested item produces a new queued post with title/body/excerpt populated and mapped to one of the site’s existing categories used by the frontend.
Failures to fetch/parse a single source do not prevent processing other sources; errors are recorded in a retrievable status log for admins.

requirements.text: Implement a daily automated ingestion trigger in the backend that runs the fetch+ingest job once per day, and also expose an admin-only "Run ingestion now" method for manual triggering.

quotes: every day you web is scrapping means online you search everything and automatically update and add every day daily news and educational use whatever the content related to my website.

acceptanceCriteria: There is a backend mechanism to run ingestion automatically on a daily cadence (best-effort).
Admins can manually trigger ingestion on-demand via an admin-only backend method.
The last run time and last run outcome (success/partial/failure + counts) are queryable by admins.

requirements.text: Add backend support to automatically set or refresh post hero images based on admin-configured image rules: for each ingested item, derive an image URL (from the source item when available) or fall back to a category image; validate that the stored image URL is non-empty and usable by the frontend.

quotes: online fetching images and automatically you update the images

acceptanceCriteria: When a source item includes an image URL (or equivalent), the ingested post’s imageUrl is set to it; otherwise, the post uses the existing category fallback behavior.
Image URLs saved to posts are normalized to a string that the frontend can load (http(s) URL or existing site asset path).
The frontend UpdateCard fallback behavior remains functional when an image fails to load.

requirements.text: Add a simple admin UI screen (owner/admin-only) to manage automation settings: content sources list, a "Run ingestion now" button, and a status panel showing last run time, counts, and recent errors.

quotes: automate this website... every day... automatically update and add every day daily news

acceptanceCriteria: Only authorized admins can access the automation settings screen (reuse existing admin guard patterns).
Admin can add/edit/enable/disable/remove content sources from the UI.
Admin can click "Run ingestion now" and see a success/error result in the UI.
The UI displays last run time and basic ingestion stats returned from the backend.

requirements.text: Replace hardcoded site branding image usage with a backend-configurable "brand image" so the logo/brand image can be updated centrally (supporting the user’s request to update images wherever the brand name is used).

quotes: automatically you update the images wherever you have written the Aurora Studios

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes admin-only methods to set/update a brand image reference (at minimum a URL string, optionally backed by stored asset bytes using existing storage mixins).
Frontend header logo uses the backend-configured brand image reference, with a safe fallback to the existing static logo if none is configured or load fails.
Brand image can be updated by an admin without redeploying the frontend.

requirements.text: Apply a cohesive, editorial-style visual theme refresh (warm neutrals, high-contrast typography, subtle paper-like surfaces) consistently across key pages (Home, list pages, Post detail, header/footer) without changing site structure or routes.
acceptanceCriteria: Colors/typography/spacing feel consistent across header, footer, cards, and page sections.
No routes are removed; existing navigation remains intact.
Theme avoids blue/purple as the primary brand palette.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only Shadcn components must be composed, not modified).
Do not edit frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts or frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts or frontend/src/main.tsx (immutable paths).
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor with all core logic in backend/main.mo; only introduce backend/migration.mo if an upgrade-safe state migration is required.

Automation must not rely on unrestricted "search the whole web" scraping; ingestion must be limited to explicit admin-configured sources/endpoints that can be fetched over HTTPS and parsed deterministically.
Keep existing SEO verification meta tags intact (e.g., Google Search Console tag in frontend/index.html).
nonGoals: Building a general-purpose web crawler that searches arbitrary websites without configured feeds/APIs.
Integrating third-party AI/LLM services for rewriting or summarization.
Circumventing copyright/terms-of-service restrictions for third-party content/images.

edits: Crop/resize for a wide hero/card-safe aspect ratio and export (ncert-launches-portal-for-home-delivery-of-books.jpg > ncert-sample-papers.dim_1600x900.jpg)
